pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 VERBS AND TENSE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and Tense

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and Tense
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to use correct tenses in communication?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify regular and irregular verbs in sentences
2. use regular and irregular verbs to construct sentences using the past, present, and future tenses
3. appreciate the correct use of verbs and tenses for effective communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and Tense

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and Tense

Teach
• Focus skill: identify regular and irregular verbs in sentences.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and Tense.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and Tense
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to use correct tenses in communication?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
